scope: Short SQLite checks only; no service startup or engine/replica mutation

database.resolved_config: tests/TestCase.php getEnvironmentSetUp installs testbench and secondary from databaseConnectionConfig; sqlite resolves exactly :memory:
database.runtime_guard: tests/Fixtures/Visibility/VisibilityWorld.php and CRM fixture enforce SQLite :memory: before writes

filesystem.generators_install: tests/Fixtures/Console/GeneratedApp.php uses random azguard-generated-* directory, unique namespace, restores basePath and deletes only its owned directory
filesystem.catalog: CatalogCacheTest/RoleOriginCollisionTest use random azguard-catalog-* or azguard-role-origins-* paths
filesystem.testbench: Package tests use Orchestra disposable application; no host application or production filesystem supplied
filesystem.excluded_cleanup: No deletion of legacy directories or /tmp/azguard-install-debug-output

execution: check.py unsets replica override and forces SQLite/testing in subprocess environment; each short check has 30-second deadline; long gates are not launched
